user.title: Choose rooms
user.description: Step 1: Choose rooms. Lights, speakers and cameras are found automatically.

devices.title: Manual devices
devices.description: Adjust devices and optional view restriction. Language, AI and source fields are not repeated.

placement.title: 2 · Robot
placement.description: Choose language, dashboards and AI assistant. These choices appear only here.

sources.title: Information from your integrations
sources.description: Review function sources once. Additional readings are kept on a separate optional page. Empty fields are optional.

integrations.title: 3 · Integrations
integrations.description: Choose integrations. Next, review function sources once. Manual devices and extra readings are optional.

readings.title: Extra readings
readings.description: Optional: choose additional readings. Existing choices are preserved when this page is skipped.

data.read_entities: Other information the robot may read

error.invalid_paths: Enter dashboard paths without host or subpages, separated by commas.
